title: 第三章 王昱 又是我第四章 严老死了
content_zh:
李云岫的面色冷了下来。
王昱初得内力，而且浅薄，此时只能看到两个蓝衣人展现出如电视中的轻功，如蜻蜓点水般飞掠而至，手中剑光闪烁，却看不清长剑制式。
马车边的禁卫纷纷拔刀，禁卫什长宋勇拔刀纵马，就要上前。
“回来！你不是对手！”李云岫轻喝道。
宋勇一个迟疑，两个蓝衣人就到了他面前，他虽然急躲，但依然只觉得眼前剑光一闪，肩膀和肋下都是一痛，不由翻身坠马。
“好快的剑！”
宋勇心中骇然，急忙扭头，就看到两人已经到了马车前方。
南海双剑根本就不在意拦在马车前的几个禁卫，身形一纵便腾跃半空，目光直视马车中的王昱和李云岫。
王昱甚至能看到他们眼中的杀意。
不过王昱却并不害怕。
他虽然刚刚穿越，但见识还在，李云岫刚刚才和自己说过有高手陪同在侧，此时不仅面无惧色，而且还和自己侃侃而谈，那自己有什么可害怕的？
果然，高手在下一刻就出手了。
不过并不是王昱以为的隐藏在禁卫里，而是那个头发花白的老车夫。
就在南海双剑跨越车前禁卫，飞掠至两匹马的上方时，老车夫翻了他们一眼，甚至有空将手中的旱烟杆在车边敲了敲，这才向上斜打。
一支比普通旱烟杆长了一尺的烟杆突然探入两团剑光之间，正好卡在人与剑的中间，一拨一打，一转一敲。
南海双剑大惊失色，手腕急翻，收剑护身，却依然赶不上烟杆的变化，两人只感觉手上合谷穴与神门穴一痛，手上微麻，长剑便脱手飞出。
“哚！哚！”两声，两柄长剑斜飞钉入地下，摇晃不定，光影闪烁、
长剑脱手，南海双剑神色剧变，但终究是老江湖，应变极为迅捷，此时身在半空，腾挪不便，立刻一伸左掌一伸右掌，就在半空对了一掌，向左右翻身。
但他们快，老车夫的旱烟杆却更快，打落了他们的长剑之后，便如附骨之疽般随身而上，残影如蛇，左右变幻，竟然一人打出了两人的效果。
一路向上，尺泽、天府、云门，然后再一路向下，神藏、巨阙、章门，最后在膝盖处犊鼻穴上一点。

老车夫收了旱烟杆，再次坐回到车前御位，而南海双剑则飞掠至马车两侧。
只不过他们刚一站定，便感觉全身无力，双膝一软，翻倒在地。
老车夫又将旱烟杆在车边敲了敲，然后拿起来抽了一口，轻轻吐出一个烟圈，看都不看软倒在地的南海双剑。
“果然是高手！”王昱看向老车夫，他根本就没有看清老车夫刚才的动作。
与此同时，他也想通了为什么这个高手是老车夫。
按理来说，自己冒充赵昱乃是绝密，除了皇帝和自己之外，只有王妃李云岫和侍女紫菱知道，但她们却明目张胆的在车厢里和自己介绍相关情况。
几个禁卫远离马车，听不到车内说话，但驾驶马车的车夫，绝对是能听到的。
如果车夫只是个普通人，岂能容他知道如此绝密，就算他发誓守口如瓶，也免不了被灭口一途，但如果是保护王昱的大高手，那就完全说得通了。
而且还能守在车外，防止外人听到车中的讨论。
“严老辛苦。”
王昱还在思考，身边的李云岫已经道一声谢，然后轻身下车。
她先将宋勇扶起来，封住他几处穴道帮他止血，又招来两个禁卫替他包扎，“你躲闪及时，都是皮外伤，不碍事。”
content_en:
Li Yunxiu's expression turned cold.
Wang Yu had just gained internal strength, and it was very shallow. At this time, he could only see the two men in blue showing lightness skills like those on TV, flying over like dragonflies in the water. The light of the swords in their hands flickered, but he couldn't see clearly the format of the long swords.
The guards beside the carriage drew their swords one after another. Song Yong, the chief of the guards, drew his sword and rode his horse, about to step forward.
"Come back! You are no match!" Li Yunxiu shouted softly.
Song Yong hesitated, and two men in blue arrived in front of him. Although he hurriedly hid, he still felt a flash of sword light in front of his eyes, a pain in his shoulders and ribs, and he couldn't help but turn over and fall from his horse.
"What a fast sword!"
Song Yong was horrified, turned his head hurriedly, and saw that the two of them had arrived in front of the carriage.
Nanhai Shuangjian didn't care at all about the few guards blocking the carriage. He leaped into the air and looked directly at Wang Yu and Li Yunxiu in the carriage.
Wang Yu could even see the killing intent in their eyes.
But Wang Yu was not afraid.
Although he had just traveled through time, his knowledge was still there. Li Yunxiu had just told him that he was accompanied by a master. Not only was he not showing any fear at this time, but he was also talking to him. So what did he have to be afraid of?
Sure enough, the master took action at the next moment.
But it wasn't the gray-haired old coachman who was hiding among the guards as Wang Yu thought.
Just as Nanhai's double swords crossed over the guards in front of the carriage and flew over the two horses, the old coachman glanced at them, and even had time to knock the tobacco pole in his hand against the side of the carriage before striking upwards.
A cigarette stick that was one foot longer than an ordinary dry cigarette stick suddenly penetrated between the two sword lights, and got stuck between the man and the sword. It was struck and struck every time.
Nanhai's double swords turned pale with fright, their wrists turned sharply, and they sheathed their swords to protect themselves, but they still couldn't keep up with the change of the tobacco rod. They only felt pain in the Hegu and Shenmen points on their hands, and their hands were slightly numb, and the sword flew out.
"Dang! Dang!" Two sounds, two long swords flew diagonally and were nailed into the ground, shaking unsteadily, light and shadow flickering,
The long sword was released, and the expressions of the two swords of Nanhai changed drastically. But after all, it was Lao Jianghu who responded very quickly. He was in mid-air and could not move easily. He immediately stretched out his left palm and his right palm, met his palm in mid-air, and turned to the left and right.
But they were fast, but the old coachman's tobacco pole was even faster. After knocking off their long swords, they followed them up like gangrene in their bones. Their afterimages were like snakes, changing left and right. One person actually had the same effect as two people.
All the way up, Chize, Tianfu, Yunmen, then all the way down, Shenzang, Jique, Zhangmen, and finally a little above the Dubi point on the knee.
The old coachman put away the dry tobacco pole and sat back in the imperial seat in front of the carriage again, while the two swords of Nanhai flew to both sides of the carriage.
But as soon as they stood still, they felt weak all over, their knees gave out, and they fell to the ground.
The old coachman knocked the dry tobacco stick against the car again, then picked it up and took a puff, then gently blew out a smoke ring without looking at the Nanhai swords that fell limply to the ground.
"Sure enough, he is a master!" Wang Yu looked at the old coachman, but he didn't see clearly what the old coachman had just done.
At the same time, he also figured out why this master was an old coachman.
Logically speaking, his impersonation of Zhao Yu was a top secret. Apart from the emperor and himself, only Princess Li Yunxiu and maid Ziling knew about it, but they blatantly introduced the relevant situation to him in the carriage.
Several guards were far away from the carriage and could not hear the conversation inside the carriage, but the driver driving the carriage could definitely hear it.
If the coachman was just an ordinary person, how could he be allowed to know such a top secret? Even if he swore to keep his mouth shut, he would inevitably be silenced. But if he was a master who protected Wang Yu, it would make perfect sense.
And you can also stay outside the car to prevent outsiders from hearing the discussions in the car.
"Old Yan has worked hard."
Wang Yu was still thinking, but Li Yunxiu beside him already thanked him and got out of the car.
She first helped Song Yong up, sealed several of his acupuncture points to help him stop bleeding, and then called two guards to bandage him, "If you dodge in time, it's just a skin injury and it won't be a problem. "
